newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Benpres unit, Nynex to expand phone service.
newsitem.headline: Benpres unit, Nynex to expand phone service.

text.p: Bayan Telecommunications Holdings Corp (BayanTel) said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Nynex Corp of the United States to expand their telecommunication services in the Philippines.
BayanTel is the telecom subsidiary of utility-based holding firm Benpres Holdings Corp. Nynex has a minority stake in BayanTel.
BayanTel said the two telephone companies will establish direct correspondent relations as the United States has allowed Nynex to provide international message telephone services.

"The MOU ... calls on BayanTel and Nynex to also explore the possibility of putting up direct international circuits either through undersea fibre optic cables or satellite systems," BayanTel said in a statement.
